alex (marketing): Quick coordination thread — aiming for Tue 08:00 PT public announce. Need final changelog, docs URL, and a one-line bench we can put in the hero of the blog. Any API breaking changes?
rachel (eng): No breaking changes. Introducing rwd-4-quant-small and a `perf_mode` toggle. Draft changelog incoming.
sam (docs): I can publish the release page as soon as I get the changelog + a sample curl. ETA EOD today.
alex (marketing): Great. Also scheduling a short webinar Wed 11am PT (20-30m). Priya will run demo; we need 2 slides: p50/p95 and cost delta plus a short note on tradeoffs.
priya (product): Confirmed. Please give bench numbers for the common 128-token prompt. Short caption only.
rachel (eng): Quick bench highlight: rwd-4-quant-small, 128-token gen -> p50=38ms, p95=110ms, ~32% token-cost reduction vs rwd-4-small. We'll include exact config in docs.
emma (growth): For inbound routing: route the blog leads to sales@redwood, add Drift tag "quant-bench", and capture company + expected monthly tokens on the lead form. Can ops set a lead template?
sam (docs): Placeholder doc URL: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/rwd-4-quant-1782401234 — will swap when published. Adding Upgrade Notes: opt-in model name change; no forced migration. Also adding short FAQ about quality vs cost.
rachel (eng): Changelog draft bullets:
- Add rwd-4-quant-small (4-bit) with ~32% token-cost reduction
- KV-cache path optimizations for lower repeat-prefix latency
- New `perf_mode` runtime flag for tuning continuous batching behavior
Sample curl for docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4-quant-small","input":"Draft a product intro paragraph","max_tokens":128}'
```
alex (marketing): Sam — can you link that curl and the changelog into the blog draft? Emma — will you confirm Drift tag + lead template Monday AM?
sam (docs): Yep, linking both. I'll also add an "FAQ: when to use quantized model" short blurb.
priya (product): Rollout ask: engineering OK to canary Mon 23:45 PT at 10% and full ramp Tue 04:30 PT?
rachel (eng): Canary Mon 23:45 PT -> 10% traffic. Monitor error rate, p95 latency, and token cost delta. Full ramp Tue 04:30 PT if metrics stable. I'll leave the release notes in draft until embargo lifts.
alex (marketing): Embargo internal until Tue 07:30 PT — marketing will finalize assets after docs link lands. Webinar signup landing to include blog + docs links.
emma (growth): Landing page + signup live Mon morning. I'll confirm the Drift tag and sample lead email template once set.
deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy canary_start=1782467100, full_ramp=1782501000
alex (marketing): Action items: Rachel finish changelog + bench config (TODAY EOD), Sam publish docs draft (TODAY EOD), Emma landing + lead routing ready Mon AM, Priya to prepare webinar agenda and slides. I will assemble blog draft Mon 09:00 PT and request reviews. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is done.
rachel (eng): On it — will drop bench config here when ready.
sam (docs): Publishing draft later today.
priya (product): I'll share webinar outline and calendar invite.
emma (growth): Drift tag & lead template in progress.
alex (marketing): Thanks team! :raised_hands:
